caption:
Different currency? Different context.

A price recorded in your store’s main currency is not a separate history of every amount offered in another currency or market. Do not present those as the same record.

India Prior Price currently shows the observed prior price only when customers shop in the store’s main currency. It hides the display in other storefront currencies.

Knowing that limit makes setup and customer questions simpler. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
